profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer at Liberty Mutual Insurance
profile.geoLocationName: Olde West Chester, Ohio, United States
profile.summary: I'm a software developer who is passionate about cloud computing, especially in the area of serverless architecture. I'm always looking for challenges that will help me learn new skills and technologies.

positions.title: Associate Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Developing orchestration application using Spring Boot and Apache Camel
- Developing a Serverless application on AWS using Lambda, Step Functions, S3, SQS, CloudFormation, and CloudWatch.
- Developing an in-house AngularJS application using Spring Boot backend and Netflix Zuul reverse proxy
- Configuration of CI/CD pipelines
- Code reviews for in-house quality assurance

positions.title: Technical Consultant
positions.description: Work study position at The University of Scranton where we provide assistance to faculty, staff, and students with the use of technology for teaching and learning purposes. Services offered includes instructions on various technology and assistance with university’s learning management system. In addition, developed faculty webpages using the university’s content management system.

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description:
I work as a part time software developer developing the payroll system I worked on as an intern at the company. Currently, I am in the process of implementing the system using a Model View Controller Architecture using CodeIgniter Web Framework.

Work Summary:
- Developed the system using PHP, HTML, CSS, and JS.
- Designed and implemented MVC using Codeigniter Framework
- Reevaluated and improved many features as progressing from Plain PHP to MVC
- High quality structured code
- Optimized the database to use foreign key constraints
- Developed reporting functions with PDF outputs
- Managed the codebase with GIT for better control over versions

positions.title: Software Developer Intern
positions.description: Held an intern position during intersession of 2015 as a software developer. I was a part of a small development team who worked on creating a payroll processing software. Developed some of the core functionality of the software, such as logging hours worked by employees, entering tax deductions, computing payroll and tax deductions, and generating reports. This software was primarily developed using PHP and HTML; and occasionally Javascript to allow interactivity on the webpage.

projects.title: Iris, Software Engineering Thesis Project
projects.description: Iris will be an interactive system that will essentially duplicate the behavior of a large touchscreen display using hand gestures supported by Microsoft’s Kinect Device; the system will provide various information such as the building map, building directory, news, weather, sports, and more. Traditionally, the content displayed on such information displays is very limited and is presented as static images or some sort of carousel of images or text, which restricts the user to only view what is being displayed at that moment. The goal of this system is to give its users' the ability to interact with the display and give them the control to make information readily available.
